scope: Untimed qualification serialization and explicit supported profile; no runtime or performance acceptance

schedule.origin: First drained before-phase host boundary observing E9_AFTER and the unchanged successful setup RPC fence, after draining actual terminal replies; retain a native/state witness. All later targets remain absolute.
schedule.absoluteOffsets: 500000 * frame index, frame index 1..100; never relative sleep after auxiliary work
schedule.normalOffer: Substitute FRAME_INDEX in the original template, append one newline.
schedule.tenthOffer: The same frame command and newline, then original rewrite command with INDEX 1..10 and newline, all in one UART offer.
schedule.authoritativeEvidence: Actual channel-1 accepted offer receipts, exact payload bytes and coordinates; separate setup and auxiliary GPU-control ledgers.
schedule.setup: Run original setup unchanged and its original advance exchange. Auxiliary network setup, probe transfer/library inspection and viewport controls do not change that source or count among the 100.
schedule.auxiliaryLedger: Every channel-1 offer belongs to exactly one predeclared producer: original setup, advance, actual terminal reply, scheduled frame, network setup, probe transfer/inspection/invocation or explicit file/guest inspection. Retain full source coordinates, sequence, byte length and SHA-256; their disjoint union must cover all UART offers. Viewport controls and GPU observations have separate typed projections of the same durable stream.

profiles.software: Original full Alpine assets, 256 MiB RAM, one hart, pure ICount/10.
profiles.desktop: Original Omarchy kernel and raw pinned 8a793846f109a08242688fa32d531f230d7a3e2a7bdb3c694dbfc1abb70367a8 manifest (12 GiB base), one GiB RAM, one hart, fresh pure ICount/64 with interactive:null; no historical paced warm checkpoint.
profiles.historicalCandidate: Preserve original T01 paced-on-keyboard candidate and its asset/renderer identities; this qualification does not coerce that checkpoint.
profiles.renderer: Production physical renderer; pin host and guest identities, original RV64 EGL/GLES probe source/compiler/sysroot/binary and actual guest-resolved library identities before timing.

history: Capture and reopen complete histories from actual initial frames through their ends; no final-keyframe shortcut, partial-prefix acceptance, fixture substitution or hidden live replay I/O.
capacity: Existing runtime bounds remain unchanged. An actual full-workload failure at those bounds requires its own ordered runtime prerequisite.
numericBudgets: All original T01 values and all original workload amounts remain unchanged. Later timing is E9-T22d.
